name: Goal Seek Wrapper
short_desc: A reusable wrapper for Excel's Goal Seek functionality.
code_text:
Sub GoalSeekWrapper()
    ' Modify cell references to match your scenario
    Range("B10").GoalSeek Goal:=1000, ChangingCell:=Range("B5")
End Sub
notes: User needs to update cell references for their specific scenario.
prompt: Use goal seek to find the value in B5 that makes B10 equal 1000

name: Delete All Empty Rows
short_desc: Removes all completely empty rows from the used range of the active worksheet.
code_text:
Sub DeleteEmptyRows()
    Dim i As Long
    For i = ActiveSheet.UsedRange.Rows.Count To 1 Step -1
        If Application.CountA(Rows(i)) = 0 Then
            Rows(i).Delete
        End If
    Next i
End Sub
notes: Loops in reverse to avoid skipping rows after deletion.
prompt: Delete all the blank rows in my sheet

name: Unhide All Worksheets
short_desc: Makes all hidden worksheets in the workbook visible.
code_text:
Sub UnhideAllWorksheets()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        ws.Visible = xlSheetVisible
    Next ws
End Sub
prompt: Unhide all the hidden sheets in my workbook

name: Wrap Formulas with IFERROR
short_desc: Automatically wraps selected Excel formulas with IFERROR to handle errors gracefully, replacing them with a blank string.
code_text:
Sub WrapWithIFERROR()
    Dim cell As Range
    For Each cell In Selection
        If cell.HasFormula Then
            cell.Formula = "=IFERROR(" & Mid(cell.Formula, 2) & ","""")"
        End If
    Next cell
End Sub
notes: Works on the current selection. Uses Mid to strip the leading = before wrapping.
prompt: Wrap all the formulas in my selection with IFERROR so errors show blank

name: Select Unique Non-Blank Values
short_desc: Selects all unique non-blank values from a selected range.
code_text:
Sub SelectUniqueNonBlankValues()
    Dim rng As Range, cell As Range
    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Set rng = Selection.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeConstants)
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    
    For Each cell In rng
        If Len(Trim(cell.Value)) > 0 Then
            dict(cell.Value) = 1
        End If
    Next cell
End Sub
notes: Uses Scripting.Dictionary for uniqueness. Only processes constant cells, not formulas.
prompt: Get all the unique non-blank values from my selection

name: Format Selection as Number
short_desc: Formats selected cells as numbers with thousand separators and center alignment.
code_text:
Sub FormatSelectionAsNumber()
    ' Apply thousand separators, no decimals, and center alignment
    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then Exit Sub

    With Selection
        .NumberFormat = "#,##0"
        .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
    End With
End Sub
notes: Includes a TypeName guard in case the selection isn't a range.
prompt: Format the selected cells as numbers with commas and center them

name: Export All Sheets as PDF
short_desc: Saves every worksheet in the active workbook as a separate PDF file to a specified folder on your desktop.

Sub SaveWorkshetAsPDF()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In Worksheets
        ws.ExportAsFixedFormat xlTypePDF, "C:\Users\Sumit\Desktop\Test\" & ws.Name & ".pdf"
    Next ws
End Sub

name: Save Workbook with Timestamp
short_desc: Saves the current workbook with a timestamp appended to the filename.
code_text:
Sub SaveWorkbookWithTimeStamp()
    Dim timestamp As String
    timestamp = Format(Date, "dd-mm-yyyy") & "_" & Format(Time, "hh-ss")
    ThisWorkbook.SaveAs "C:\Users\Username\Desktop\WorkbookName" & timestamp
End Sub
notes: Hardcoded path. User should replace with their own path or use ThisWorkbook.Path.
prompt: Save my workbook with today's date and time in the filename

name: Sort Sheets by Tab Name
short_desc: Sorts all worksheets in the active workbook alphabetically by their tab names (sheet names).
code_text:
Sub SortSheetsTabName()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Dim ShCount As Integer, i As Integer, j As Integer
    ShCount = Sheets.Count
    For i = 1 To ShCount - 1
        For j = i + 1 To ShCount
            If Sheets(j).Name < Sheets(i).Name Then
                Sheets(j).Move before:=Sheets(i)
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub
notes: Bubble sort implementation. Disables screen updating for performance.
prompt: Sort all my sheet tabs alphabetically

name: Hide All Except Active Sheet
short_desc: Hides all worksheets in the current workbook except for the currently active sheet.
code_text:
Sub HideAllExceptActiveSheet()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        If ws.Name <> ActiveSheet.Name Then ws.Visible = xlSheetHidden
    Next ws
End Sub
prompt: Hide every sheet except the one I'm on right now
